## About
Prime Texas Air is a heating, ventilation, air conditioning and refrigeration company based in The Woodlands. When your AC stops cooling, we come out, figure out what is wrong, and make sure the system is running right before we leave.
Our customers have given us a 5 rating across 26 Google reviews. Reviewers talk about clear explanations, fair prices, and a technician who treats the house with respect. Some even mention Nate by name.

## Services
- AC repair: We diagnose the cooling problem, complete the repair, and check that the system is cooling properly before we head out.
- AC installation: When it is time for new equipment, we go over the available options, answer your questions, and do the installation cleanly.
- Thermostat and fuse help: Put in a new thermostat and now the AC won't come on? We can find the issue and get you cooling again.

## FAQ
Q: What kind of work do you do?
A: Heating, ventilation, air conditioning and refrigeration.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday from 8 AM to 6 PM. We are closed Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Where are you located?
A: Our office is at 8505 Technology Forest Pl Ste 501, The Woodlands, TX.
